parsed.rationale: Although the `is_sample_app` flag is false on both records, the second participating file lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` path — a structural restraint marker that dominates action signals under the decision rules. The first record is production code in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`). Consolidating the two copies would couple the sample-app demonstration target to the production `DebugPanel` package, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. The duplication is intentional: the sample app carries its own inline copy of `measureCPUUsage` so it can remain self-contained without a hard dependency on `DebugPanel`.
